newsitem.title: USA: Seagram to buy back more shares.
newsitem.headline: Seagram to buy back more shares.

text.p: Seagram Co Ltd said on Friday it had renewed its share repurchase program, authorizing the company to buy back up to three percent of its outstanding common stock.
The percentage is based on shares outstanding as of September 13.
Seagram said three percent would mean 11.1 million of the 370.5 million shares outstanding on September 13.
Seagram may purchase the shares on the open market from time to time over the 12 months beginning September 27.

The company's previous share repurchase program terminates effective September 26. Under that program, 4,859,100 shares had been purchased as of September 13 at an average price of US$32.62, the company said.
